name: Gershon
overview: Gershon, also referred to as Gershom, is identified in Scripture as one of the three sons of Levi, alongside Kohath and Merari, highlighting his foundational role in the Levitical lineage (Genesis 46:11; Exodus 6:16; Numbers 3:17). The genealogical details emphasize the family structure within the tribe of Levi, with Gershon himself fathering Libni and Shimi (Exodus 6:17; Numbers 3:18). These records underscore the importance of family heritage in God's covenant community and set the stage for understanding the distinct roles assigned to the Levites in service to the Lord.
